persona: Master's student excavating root systems from rice cultivars over a growing season, recording measurements and notes as field conditions allow.
source_style: field notes + lab bench measurements, manually entered into Excel with ad-hoc formatting

columns.name: Lateral Roots
columns.notes: count per excavated root, some entries as text string

columns.name: Root Biomass (g)
columns.notes: dry weight, some rows from scale malfunction (row 13)

columns.name: Soil Texture
columns.notes: Clay loam, Loam, or Sandy loam

columns.name: Soil Moisture %
columns.notes: % by weight, contains 'N/A', 'missing', and numeric gaps

clean_table: Root Data first 3 rows: [{'Date Sampled': '2024-04-15', 'Plot': 1, 'Cultivar': 'IR64', 'Root Depth (cm)': 18.5, 'Lateral Roots': 14, 'Root Biomass (g)': 2.3, 'Soil Texture': 'Clay loam', 'Soil Moisture %': 22.5, 'Notes': 'normal growth'}, {'Date Sampled': '2024-04-15', 'Plot': 2, 'Cultivar': 'IR64', 'Root Depth (cm)': 19.2, 'Lateral Roots': 15, 'Root Biomass (g)': 2.5, 'Soil Texture': 'Clay loam', 'Soil Moisture %': 22.5, 'Notes': ''}, {'Date Sampled': '2024-04-15', 'Plot': 3, 'Cultivar': 'BR11', 'Root Depth (cm)': 22.1, 'Lateral Roots': 18, 'Root Biomass (g)': 3.8, 'Soil Texture': 'Loam', 'Soil Moisture %': 24, 'Notes': 'good lateral root development'}, ...]; n=20 total; sampling dates span April 15 – May 20, 2024; three rice cultivars (IR64, BR11, Binam) measured at 3–4 time points each with 4–5 replicates per date.
intended_analysis: How does rooting depth and biomass vary among cultivars? Mixed-model regression accounting for date and cultivar effects; treatment of missing/suspect measurements (rows 4, 9, 13, 17); assessment of measurement reliability from lab notes.
mess_applied: numeric column (Lateral Roots, row 5) contains a text string '16'
missing soil moisture marked as 'N/A' (row 9) and 'missing' (row 17)
equipment/scale issues flagged in lab notes (rows 4, 9, 13, 17) affecting measurement confidence
free-form notes column with blanks, abbreviations, and qualitative remarks
no unit labels in column headers (units in Notes only)
row 13 biomass flagged as 'estimated' due to equipment malfunction
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong: A tool that doesn't account for date format variation will misparse dates or fail on rows 4 and 13. Numeric parsing will crash or coerce row 5 incorrectly. A simple mean() will silently include estimated/suspect values without flagging measurement-quality differences.
